summary: Backend testing for 'Around You' MVP complete. All 20 backend tests passed (100%) covering posts, categories, creators, admin endpoints, auth protection, and _id exclusion. Tested against public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin endpoints (/api/admin/creators, /api/admin/posts) are intentionally open per MVP spec & test_credentials.md — flag for production: add auth before launch.
CORSMiddleware uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True — acceptable for MVP preview, but in production this combination is rejected by browsers; recommend tightening origins.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in newer FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan handlers (non-blocking).
seed_data_creation: Test created one TEST_Creator and one TEST_post via admin endpoints to verify admin flow. They remain in DB (clearly TEST_ prefixed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env). Note frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL key, not EXPO_BACKEND_URL. 4 seeded creators + 18 seeded posts in DB. Auth requires real Emergent Google OAuth session — only unauth paths + 401 checks tested here.
tests_covered: GET /api/posts (no auth) — returns list with creator embedded, no _id
GET /api/posts/{post_id} — returns post+creator+related (same category, excludes self)
POST /api/admin/posts — creates post linked to creator
Protected endpoints (auth/me, bookmarks GET/POST/DELETE, follows GET/POST/DELETE) all return 401 without Bearer token
No MongoDB _id leaked in any response (posts, creators, embedded creator, post detail)
